answer: What survives to the echo is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the quill until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the glacier of the next round. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
